claims.claim_ar: صيغة فعل مضارع مبني للمجهول (معنى: يُحشَرون) بصيغة الجمع الغائب
claims.claim_en: Present-passive verb (third-person plural) of the root حشر — meaning 'to be gathered / to be resurrected' (passive voice: 'they will be gathered').
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted commentary uses the active form نَحْشُرُهُمْ; the ayah has the passive-like يُحْشَرُوا. Verify voice/inflectional differences and final vowel orthography in the manuscript used.

claims.claim_ar: اسم (رَبّ) بمعنى السيد/الرازق؛ هنا مضاف + ضمير (رَبِّهِمْ) بمعنى 'ربُّهم'.
claims.claim_en: Noun 'rabb' (Lord, Sustainer). In this form it is in construct with a pronoun: 'their Lord'.
